Event term: Sudden cardiac death
Onset: 2026-05-19
statements.text: The event in the EDC is sudden cardiac death with onset and end on 2026-05-19, recorded as serious (death), severe and fatal.

statements.quote: condition: Hypertension, ongoing: Y, start year: 2018
statements.text: The subject is a 77-year-old man with ongoing hypertension since 2018, taking amlodipine since 2024-11-01.
He was admitted to the coronary care unit on 17/05/2026 with an acute anterior myocardial infarction and troponin T of 2950 ng/L.

statements.quote: On 18/05/2026 he developed cardiogenic shock requiring inotropic support.
statements.text: On 18/05/2026 he developed cardiogenic shock that needed inotropic support, and TIMI flow grade 0 was seen in the left anterior descending artery.

statements.quote:
Resuscitation was unsuccessful
and death was confirmed at 04:15.
statements.text: On 19/05/2026 at 03:40 he had a ventricular fibrillation arrest, resuscitation was unsuccessful, and death was confirmed at 04:15.

statements.quote: Cause of death: 1a cardiogenic shock, 1b acute anterior myocardial infarction.
statements.text: The death summary records the cause of death as 1a cardiogenic shock and 1b acute anterior myocardial infarction, and says the death was reported to the coroner.
A post-mortem examination was requested, with the clinical summary given as acute anterior myocardial infarction complicated by cardiogenic shock.
